page_title_home: PicX - AI-Powered Paper Summarization & Whiteboard Generation
about_hero_subtitle: PicX is a free, open-source tool that transforms academic papers into AI-generated visual whiteboards — making research faster to read and easier to share.
about_mission_body: Dense academic papers are hard to skim. PicX extracts the key ideas and renders them as a structured whiteboard — so you can grasp a paper's contribution in minutes, not hours.
about_daily_body: PicX automatically fetches the top papers from HuggingFace Daily Papers, generates AI summaries and whiteboard images, and publishes them to the public gallery — so the latest research is always visualized and ready to explore.
about_daily_step2: PicX fetches and processes each paper
about_open_title: Free to use, free to fork
about_open_body: PicX is fully open source. Bring your own API keys, self-host it, or just use the hosted version at picx.dev — no paywalls, no subscriptions.
